first.rationale: Promotional pricing directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify its long-term revenue quality and compare it with onboarding simplification, which addresses a current funnel decline with potentially lower downstream-value risk. Until verified, use a narrowly targeted, guarded test rather than broad discounting.

mid.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified evidence shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing this cycle because its verified retention decline undermines long-term value despite short-term revenue lift.

final2.rationale: Continue with shortened onboarding. It has verified gains in completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, directly supporting sustainable qualified revenue amid current onboarding and activation declines. The competitor’s deeper cut increases urgency but does not reverse the verified evidence that a 40% targeted discount attracted cohorts with 12% lower 30-day retention. Avoid reacting with structurally harmful pricing; reassess pricing defenses when verification capacity resets.
